results.notes: Status and business identity re-confirmed (525 Milltown Rd, North Brunswick; Dr. Lucien Eid; Zalka, Lebanon satellite). Re-checked in Chrome: /, /index.html, /robots.txt and /contact all return '403 Unauthorized' to this browser while a plain HTTP fetch returns the pages, so the 403 behaviour is real; because it applies to every path including robots.txt it looks like edge/IP filtering rather than a browser-only block (inference). robots.txt explicitly allows GPTBot, OAI-SearchBot, ChatGPT-User, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, Googlebot and Google-Extended - claim holds. /contact-us.html and /appointment-request.html both return HTTP 404 (confirmed), but there is a working contact form on /contact (smbleads embed, 'CONTACT US TODAY') and an /online-forms.html page, so 'no form could be verified' understates what is there. No scheduling calendar anywhere - confirmed. Gap lowered from 4 to 3 because schema and hours exist; the real fix is making the two hours datasets agree, not adding markup from scratch.

results.notes: Everything else checked out. robots.txt: User-agent * Allow, Crawl-delay 10, Yoast sitemap - as recorded. Contact page carries a JSON-LD @graph (WebPage/Organization level) and a Gravity Form with a 'Topic of interest' select offering General Inquiry / Request a Quote / Employment plus a manual spam-check field - both claims hold. Locations page lists six sites (Wall office, Runnemede, Burlington, Morrisville PA, Jackson, Collingswood/Mt Ephraim) and none in East Brunswick. The township Route 18 page names 'NJDOT and its contractor, Earle Asphalt' with Brian Cooper at 1800 Route 34, Wall - confirming the NJDOT contractor signal. The record's own hedge that the East Brunswick address is not a published location looks right; a search snippet for an OSHA establishment record places an Earle Asphalt site at Route 18 at Arthur Street, East Brunswick (snippet only, not opened), which is consistent with a plant/yard. Scores left unchanged: the corrections are cosmetic for a business this large. Google star ratings (HQ 2.3) could not be re-checked.

wrong_claims.what_is_true: The Contact page has six real <label> elements (Your Name, Phone Number, Email Address, Service Interested In, Tell Us About Your Project, Upload a Photo).
